title: WFDB toolbox
summary: Read and write PhysioNet WFDB records, signals and annotations.
description: A toolbox that owns the PhysioNet WFDB record format and returns a domain-free struct. Read and write signals and annotations, inspect headers, select channels, crop a window, validate checksums and convert signal formats. Designed to be a dependency of higher-level toolboxes such as ecglab and sleeplab.
